Joining the ongoing $50 price drop on AirPods Pro and the all-new Beats 360 headphones now available for purchase, today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by some solid M5 MacBook Air deals. Amazon has select mid-range 13-inch M5 MacBook Air models at $150 off and the official Apple refurb store is offering 15-inch models at up to $300 off today. Alongside the ongoing discount on the most affordable Apple Studio Display at $240 off, we also have $100+ off loads of M4 iPad Air models, hundreds of early Amazon fall Prime Day deals, and much more waiting below.

Mid-range 13-inch M5 MacBook Air models are $150 via Amazon right now

Alongside the ongoing AirPods Pro 3 deal, Amazon is giving folks a chance to land a mid-range 13-inch M5 MacBook Air at $150 off right now.

Amazon is offering the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB of RAM and the upgraded 1TB of storage down at $1,449 shipped.

This is a regularly $1,599 machine at $150 off the list price to land at one of the best deals we have tracked since price hikes took hold a few months ago. While not all colors are down this low right now, you can land the classic Silver, Sky Blue, and Starlight models at this price.

At this point, when it comes to the M5 MacBook Air lineup, anything in the $150 range is a solid deal. While landing one at $100 off isn’t bad, we are really looking to land closer to $150 off, especially on any of the upgraded models.

The base model isn’t seeing any significant deals at the moment, but Amazon does also have the 13-inch model with 24GB of RAM and 1TB storage sitting at $1,649 shipped – this is also $150 off the list price.

M5 MacBook Air 15-inch models are up to $300 off via official Apple refurb store right now

While we are tracking $150 off brand new condition 13-inch M5 MacBook Air models at Amazon today, the official Apple refurb store has some great deals on the 15-inch models if you’re quick – we are tracking up to $300 off right now. Details below.

Head over to this page and select MacBook Air on the left hand side – this will show you all of the in-stock M5 models you can land at a discount right now.

However, the real highlights here, while they stick around anyway, are the entry 15-incher and the 24GB/1TB models at $230 and $300 off the new list prices:

  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,269 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • Midnight, Silver, Starlight, Sky Blue
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,699 (Reg. $1,999 new)
  • Midnight, Starlight, Sky Blue

Here are the details on units from the official Apple refurb store:

  • Rigorous refurbishment process prior to sale
  • Covered by Apple’s one-year limited warranty
  • Covered by Apple’s 14-day returns policy
  • AppleCare product can be purchased
  • Engraving and gift wrap not available for refurbished products
  • Supplies are limited

Apple’s most affordable M4 iPad Air models are $100 off, 1TB now $150 off

Amazon is currently offering a range of M4 iPad Air configurations with solid $100 price drops. This includes the most affordable 11-inch and 13-inch models as well as a 1TB variant at $150 off.

Stock appears to be low on some of the color options seeing discounts right now, but you will find a series of configs with at least $100 slashed from the list prices as of the time of writing.

Today’s deals largely land on par with the most readily available discounts we have tracked on the most affordable models since the price hikes went live – just be sure to scope out that one 1TB variant you can land at $150 off right now:
